about_the_game:
Crystallium is a rhythm game where you explore the world with different companions and fight against monsters from the dungeon.

Sync Your Actions to the Beat

In Crystallium, each song becomes a thrilling battle against deadly monsters. Get ready to test your skills by pressing keys and moving your mouse simultaneously. Like other vertical-scrolling rhythm games, you'll use assigned keys to hit the notes within their respective areas. However, in Crystallium, you can utilize not just one key per area, but your entire keyboard! Moreover, when bullets and traps appear, swiftly move your character away using your mouse to ensure your team's victory in battle.

Crystallium offers four difficulty levels: "Crescent", "Lunar", "Astral", and "Bloodlust". Whether you're a beginner or a pro in rhythm games, you'll be able to enjoy a variety of levels. It also features various well-known and small and growing artists across the rhythm game scene.

Features

  • 5 Songs with four difficulties

  • Training Centre to practice your skills and learn how the game works

  • Leaderboard, beat your friend's score or conquere the world leaderboard!

  • 6 Characters with unique skills
